title: The count
style: cinematic horror film still, dramatic moody lighting with the subject clearly visible and centered, isolated log cabin on a snowy mountain during a blizzard, cold blue moonlight against warm firelight, film grain, 35mm, highly detailed, subject clearly visible, no text, no watermark
caption:
Part 2. Dad's journal had one rule. Never answer the third knock. 🚪

Original fiction. Part 3 tomorrow night.

#scarystories #horrorstory #creepy #storytime #fyp

scenes.narration: Last time: bare footprints led through fresh snow to the cabin door, and none of them led away.
scenes.image: a cabin front door at night with a line of bare footprints ending at the threshold

scenes.narration: Caleb climbed into the attic with a fire poker. Nothing. Just a draft, and a dented metal box shoved deep behind the insulation.
scenes.image: man with a flashlight and an iron fire poker crouching in a cramped cabin attic, a dented metal box

scenes.narration: Inside was Dad's journal. Forty winters of it. Firewood. Weather. Elk on the ridge. Normal things.
scenes.image: a worn leather journal resting in an open metal box, lantern light

scenes.narration: Then, in the winter of 1989, his handwriting changes. Smaller. Tighter. Like he was scared someone was reading over his shoulder.
scenes.image: close-up of cramped faded pencil scribbles on yellowed paper, illegible, lantern glow

scenes.narration: It comes in the whiteouts, he wrote. It walks to the door and it knocks. You can ignore the first. You can ignore the second. Never answer the third knock.
scenes.image: a tall dark silhouette standing on a snowy porch in a whiteout, seen through frosted glass

scenes.narration: Every storm after that had the same entry. One knock. Two knocks. Three. Then three words: did not answer. Thirty-one storms. Thirty-one nights.
scenes.image: siblings sitting on a rug by a fire, reading an old journal together, shadows on log walls

scenes.narration: The last entry was the night Dad died. No tally. Just one line. I'm so tired of not answering.
scenes.image: an old journal lying open on a wooden table beside a dying fire and a stub of pencil

scenes.narration: Nora closed the book. Neither of them said anything. Outside, the wind dropped. The snow went silent.
scenes.image: falling snow suddenly still and silent around a lonely cabin in moonlight

scenes.narration: And something knocked on the door. Once.
scenes.image: cabin front door from inside, firelight on the wood, a couch pushed against it

scenes.narration: Caleb looked at Nora. Nora looked at the door. And very quietly, Caleb started to count.
scenes.image: a bearded man's face lit by firelight, lips moving, eyes fixed on a door
